CoAP_Config.label: CoAP Config
CoAP_Config.description: This object is used to configure the CoAP transmission parameters (RFC7252) and other parameters that affect CoAP transmission.

Network_Bearer.label: Network Bearer
Network_Bearer.description: Identify the network bearer for which these parameters are applicable. The value is from the network bearer list defined in the Connectivity Monitoring Object (ID: 4). Please, verify the list of currently reserved values.

ACK_TIMEOUT.label: ACK_TIMEOUT
ACK_TIMEOUT.description: The initial value of retransmission timeout in CoAP. Default is set to that of RFC7252, that is 2 seconds.

ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR.label: ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR
ACK_RANDOM_FACTOR.description: The initial value of retransmission timeout in CoAP. Default is set to that of RFC7252, that is a value of 1.5.

MAX_RETRANSMIT.label: MAX_RETRANSMIT
MAX_RETRANSMIT.description: The maximum number of retransmissions. Default is set to that of RFC7252, that is 4 retransmissions.

NSTART.label: NSTART
NSTART.description: Number of simultaneous outstanding interactions that the LwM2M client can accept from a given LwM2M Server. An outstanding interaction is either a CON for which an ACK has not yet been received but is still expected (message layer) or a request for which neither a response nor an Acknowledgment message has yet been received but is still expected. Default is set to that of RFC7252, that is 1 interaction.

DEFAULT_LEISURE.label: DEFAULT_LEISURE
DEFAULT_LEISURE.description: If a server does decide to respond to a multicast request, it should not respond immediately. Instead, it should pick based on RFC7252, Section 8.2. If the LwM2M Client does not have data to compute the Leisure time it should use that of Default Leisure as specified in RFC7252.

PROBING_RATE.label: PROBING_RATE
PROBING_RATE.description: This resource represents the maximum probing rate accepted by this LwM2M Client in bytes per second.

DTLS_Retransmission_Timer.label: DTLS Retransmission Timer
DTLS_Retransmission_Timer.description: The LwM2M Server may modify the initial DTLS retransmission timer value of 1 second into a different value. This will have effects on latency as well as on congestion, thus the timer value should be handled carefully.

Max_Response_Waiting_Time.label: Max Response Waiting Time
Max_Response_Waiting_Time.description: The maximum time in seconds the device will wait for a separate response to a request.

Apply.label: Apply
Apply.description: Applies the parameters specifed in the resources to the CoAP connections on this interface.
